videos.title: Cheap Places to Visit in 2027
videos.tiktok_text:
Cheap Places to Visit in 2027. Cheap places to visit: 6 destinations where your money goes a long way.

1. Córdoba, Spain: around £111pp for 1 night, flights not included. Things to do: Mezquita-Cathedral, Jewish Quarter.

2. Samarkand, Uzbekistan: around £124pp for 3 nights, flights not included. Things to do: Registan, Shah-i-Zinda.

3. Riga, Latvia: around £170pp for 2 nights, flights not included. Things to do: Art Nouveau district, Central Market in zeppelin hangars.

4. Lisbon, Portugal: around £233pp for 3 nights, flights not included. Things to do: Tram 28 ride, Belém pastéis de nata.

5. Cairo, Egypt: around £300pp for 5 nights, flights not included. Things to do: Pyramids of Giza, Khan el-Khalili bazaar.

6. Medellín, Colombia: around £702pp for 6 nights, flights not included. Things to do: Comuna 13 graffiti tour, Guatapé day trip.

Prices are per person, flights not included.

videos.title: Shockingly Cheap Couples Trips That Look Luxury
videos.tiktok_text:
Shockingly Cheap Couples Trips That Look Luxury. These 6 places look like they cost a fortune, but hotels and food cost far less than the photos suggest.

1. Paros, Greece: around £264pp for 3 nights, flights not included. Try: Naoussa harbour at sunset.

2. Ksamil, Albania: around £302pp for 4 nights, flights not included. Try: Swim to the Ksamil islands.

3. Ohrid, North Macedonia: around £315pp for 3 nights, flights not included. Try: Church of St John at Kaneo.

4. Lucerne, Switzerland: around £482pp for 2 nights, flights not included. Try: Chapel Bridge.

5. Hoi An, Vietnam: around £570pp for 5 nights, flights not included. Try: Ancient Town.

6. Kyoto, Japan: around £724pp for 7 nights, flights not included. Try: Fushimi Inari at dawn.

Prices are per person, flights not included.

Flights are extra: roughly £40 to £720 return from the UK depending on where you go.
